item.title: We're Putting AI Everywhere Before It's Sustainable
item.description: We are making an expensive, resource-intensive technology artificially accessible and encouraging mass adoption before we’ve established that its widespread use is economically and environmentally sustainable. Something about the current wave of AI adoption doesn’t sit right with me. Every product is adding AI features. Existing products are being rebuilt around it, and developers keep finding creative ways to put it into problems that were already solved quite well. I get the excitement.
